flow.name: stage_b_firmware
flow.step:
adapter_count="$(adapterctl query --count)" if [ "$adapter_count" -ne "$EXPECT_ADAPTERS" ]; then echo "ERROR: unexpected adapter count" RESULT FAIL fi
current_fw="$(adapterctl query --firmware | sort -u)" if [ "$current_fw" = "$WANT_ADAPTER_FW" ]; then RESULT PASS fi
if ! adapterctl burn --firmware "$WANT_ADAPTER_FW"; then echo "ERROR: adapter firmware update failed" RESULT FAIL fi
SET HOST_REBOOT_NEEDED=yes RESULT PASS
echo "ERROR: firmware flow failed" RESULT FAIL
